# Contributing

Welcome to SGDS! You are welcome to file issues or make pull requests to help improve the documentation portal.

## Raising an Issue

Follow the issue template provided. Include screenshots or page URLs where relevant to help us understand the problem.

## Making Pull Requests

Follow the PR template and ensure:
- `pnpm docs:build` passes
- You've visually verified your changes with `pnpm docs:dev`
- Tag a reviewer to get your PR checked

See the [Contributing Guide](../Contributing.md) in the repo root for full setup instructions.
